title: Momoi Airi — That's So Unfair!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: The Sounds of a Summer Festival!

rows.Line: Summer Festival Fairgrounds

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, I was wondering why so many people were wearing yukatas and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. They're having a festival today!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, it could be fun!
Wanna check it out since we're here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, there's so many people.
I wish Minori and Haruka were here to see this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it's too bad they're off at the Seaside School.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We can at least take some pictures and show them later.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, look!
We can play ring toss or try catching some goldfish!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, yeah. It wouldn't be much of a festival if it didn't have those.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, let's look around, take some pics and tell them about it tomorrow or something.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, that sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now that I think about it, it's been quite a while since I last went to a festival like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same.
Hmm... Maybe not since elementary school...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's been about that long for me too. I remember going to the festival put on by our local shrine with Shii and our mother while wearing yukatas together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, my sisters and I used to save up just for that and go together the three of us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looking back, those really were fun times.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, wait! Have you seen any stalls selling chilled pineapples? My little sister absolutely loved them...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That does sound nice. Caramel apples and cotton candy are also good options.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, those too! I get that it's bad manners to eat while walking around...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But it's a festival, so whatever, right? It was nice to sort of do whatever we liked...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see. In my case...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm? Shizuku, what's up?
You stopped partway...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's just... I remember festivals being a lot of fun, but I always somehow ended up alone for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alone... You kept getting lost, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But Shii would never let me hold her hand.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Just promise to be a little more careful. You're an idol, so you need to keep a low profile and not cause a fuss by getting mad.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I understand.
I'll make sure not to lose sight of you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You really shouldn't have to try so hard to do that... It's a festival, so let's just try to have fun, alright?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Shizuku, they're selling caramel apples over there...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see. Hehe. I think I'll buy one for Shii.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I don't see why not.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Maybe I should get stuff for other people too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You mentioned that your younger sister likes chilled pineapples, no?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but it's not like she really likes pineapples or anything either. I just sort of start looking for them instinctively when I'm at festivals now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I think I know what you're saying. We think that these things taste better because of the occasion, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That really takes me back...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The festival my family and I used to go to was one of the biggest local events of the year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They even had bands and other artists come as guests and perform on-stage...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That does sound like a big event. The one I always went to usually had a much more traditional feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's usually how it is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, the stage seemed a little jury-rigged, and all the guests were mostly local amateurs. In that sense, it really felt like a hometown affair, you know?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That was also just around the time I started thinking about becoming an idol and even thought that I might even be performing on that stage one day.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can see you up there already, Airi, dazzling everyone with your smile.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, that stage you mentioned... Did it look anything like that?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, you're right...
I didn't realize that there was a stage there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And a pretty big one at that.
It has all the equipment it could ever need too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do they have guests scheduled to perform or something?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi, we still have quite a bit of time, so why don't we go see what's going on with that stage?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, sure!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: First, let's get some drinks to stay hydrated. Then we can just sit back and enjoy the show.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure!
